}}The '''United Congo Republic''', more commonly known as '''Congo''', is a country in Central Africa which borders the Atlantic Ocean to the west. By land area, Congo is the second-largest in Africa after the [[Tuareg Federation]]. The United Congo Republic is the most populous officially Francophone country in the world, and the national capital and largest city is Nkuna-Kinshasa, which is the nation's economic center.

The '''Horizon Party''' commonly known as '''Horizon''' is an American political party founded to unite the ideologies of [[Neo-Jeffersonianism|Neo-Jeffersonian]] and [[Postnaturalism]]. The party was a merger of the [[Liberal Party (United States)|Liberal party]] and the [[Conservative Party (United States)|Conservative party]].

[[Category:Political parties in the United States]]

'''Prometheus 1''' was an American space probe, the first to utilize a White-Alcubierre Drive or Warp Drive, which was launched to the Alpha Centauri System  11 October 2059. It was used to chart a safe course to the system and then conduct scientific surveys of the system and its planets prior to any human mission. The flight out took 18 months in which the warp drive was active for 5 jumps.

Prometheus 1 would be the progenitor to not only all [[Enterprise-class interstellar vehicle|crewed warp capable spacecraft]], but also the 18 successive probes of the Prometheus program which were used extensively by NASA to chart safe courses through interstellar space and conduct missions of exploration and scientific observation prior to human contact. As of 2160, only the Prometheus 1, 9, and 14 have survived the program, with Prometheus 1 being featured in the Smithsonian Space Museum. Prometheus 9 and 14 are still in use, orbiting the neutron stars RX J1856.5−3754 and PSR J0108−1431.

==Design==
The Prometheus project was unique among interstellar space probes in that they predate [[Chronoscope|chronoscopes]] and thus had to conduct far more warp jumps to provide an even semi-accurate simulation of interstellar space.

The '''Seikarte''' are the only [[List of Sophonts|intelligent lifeforms]] native to the planet Seika. At time of First Contact in 2071, the most advanced societies on the planet were organized into soilworks building heading communities, with a limited form of agriculture used to cultivate fodder for livestock and a type of highly fibrous or "wood" grass-like reed used in both construction and fabric. The Seikarte are one of the first Sophonts to be popularly labeled a "Wood Age" civilization, a term used to describe the bulk of post-paleolithic societies observed by humanity.
